name: ungated-feature
rule: new behavior gated behind a setting

name: sql-in-entry-point
rule: domain logic out of entry points

name: stored-ratio
rule: derive at query time, never store

name: peso-formatter
body: Moves the peso formatting of the asking price in the verification prompt behind a small helper so other prompts can reuse it.

name: sql-fragment-in-platform
body: Pulls the tier ranking CASE expression out of deals.ts into a shared fragment so later queries can rank by provenance tier without copying it.

name: io-in-pure-fn
body: Writes a line when a price is rejected as junk so odd marketplace data is visible while debugging medians.

name: magic-number
body: A listing priced above 92% off is almost always a scam or a mislabeled item, so it should not raise a notification.

name: dropped-evidence
body: A hung pinned model now hands off to the next model after 30s instead of 45s.

name: refactor-in-feature
rule: refactor never shares a commit with behavior
body: Logs how many listings each lap checks and renames explicitLimit to limitOverride, which reads better next to the settings default.

name: two-changes-one-commit
body: Smaller triage batches finish inside the gateway timeout more often, and a smaller deals pool keeps priority checks on the best-ranked listings.

name: weak-test-names
rule: test names are full sentences, add coverage
body: Covers the junk price floor and a placeholder pattern.

name: unasserted-query-shape
body: The excluded view is easier to scan when products are alphabetical and listing count only breaks ties.

name: logs-secret
body: Prints the gateway URL and key when a worker wraps its client so a misconfigured env is easy to spot in the log.

name: write-all-token
body: Some ci steps need to push regenerated files back, so grant the workflow write access.

name: unpaced-facebook
body: Rechecks now wait 0.3 to 0.8 seconds between listings so a lap finishes faster.

name: missing-force-dynamic
body: The page takes no request input, so it can be prerendered; removes the explicit dynamic export and its long comment.

name: non-idempotent-write
body: Extraction writes each listing once, so a plain insert is enough and avoids rewriting rows.

name: rule-class-hierarchy
rule: pattern only on rule of three
body: Splits the floor and placeholder checks into rule objects so more junk rules can be added without touching isJunkPrice.

name: one-impl-interface
body: Puts the junk price decision behind an interface so alternative checkers can be swapped in later.

name: crash-not-degrade
rule: degrade instead of crashing the run
body: When the gateway is unavailable the run now throws, so the worker or script reports the failure instead of logging and returning. This is intended: a loud failure is better than silently skipping products.

name: clean-tunnel-host-fix
rule: clean control: merged PR, nothing to flag
body: fix tunnel host after history scrub (real merged PR #3)

name: clean-readme-title
rule: clean control: merged PR, nothing to flag
body: rename the readme title (real merged PR #8)

name: clean-specs-move
rule: clean control: merged PR, nothing to flag
body: move specs from docs/superpowers/specs to docs/specs (real merged PR #42)

name: unbounded-retry
body: A photo download that hits a network error is almost always a one-off CDN blip, so go again instead of skipping the photo.

name: unvalidated-external-data
rule: validate external data at the boundary
body: Lets the dashboard cap a product refresh to its first N listings for a quick partial check.

name: orphaned-setting
body: Deal candidates are rechecked on every lap, so the worker no longer spaces them by hours.

name: dead-gate
rule: remove the gate once behavior is permanent
body: Deals-first checking has been on in production since 2026-10-10 and nothing has gone wrong, so make it the default.

name: hide-information
rule: module owns its data; callers do not reach into it
body: Products a human already included in pricing no longer show up in the review queue.

name: dashboard-direct-sql
rule: dashboard queries live in module queries.ts
body: Adds the unsold listing count the dashboard header will show.

name: fat-interface
body: Passes the check-listings run context to the deal candidate query so later changes need no signature change.

name: validation-removed
rule: validate external data at the boundary
body: The dashboard always sends a string id, so the handler can read it directly instead of checking it again.

name: clean-stop-collect
rule: clean control: merged PR, nothing to flag
body: make worker stop actually stop collect (real merged PR #2)

name: gate-removed-when-permanent
rule: remove the gate once behavior is permanent (clean variant: the PR removes it)
body: Deals-first checking has been on in production since 2026-10-10 and nothing has gone wrong, so delete the setting and always do it.
